input.quote: This Agreement may not be assigned by either party, by operation of law or otherwise, without the prior written consent of the other party, which consent shall not be unreasonably withheld, provided that (a) M&I's consent need not be obtained in connection with the assignment of this Agreement pursuant to a merger in which Customer is a party and as a result of which the surviving corporation becomes an Affiliate of another bank holding company, bank, savings and loan association or other financial institution having a capital and surplus of at least $100,000,000
input.rationale: Section 22.4 retains the mutual consent gate and the "not unreasonably withheld" standard, but fails the fallback in three respects. First, Customer's only consent-free route is a merger in which Customer is a party where the survivor becomes an Affiliate of a financial institution with capital and surplus of at least $100,000,000, so a sale of substantially all assets or a merger with a smaller acquirer still requires M&I's consent, while M&I may "freely assign". Second, no written notice is required for a permitted successor assignment. Third, proviso (b) let M&I escape the consent gate for assignments that are not successor transfers at all — a "corporate reorganization" and a sale of the M&I Data Services division alone under (b)(ii), where M&I itself survives — so "other assignments require consent" was not met. Our edits give Customer a symmetrical successor carve-out, add one mutual notice sentence, and confine M&I's consent-free route to a successor by merger or sale of all or substantially all of its assets, stock or securities; the Section 21.11 condition, the consent gate and the reasonableness standard are untouched, and the notice sentence tracks the existing (a)/(b) lettering. We did not pursue the preferred position, which would require deleting M&I's free-assignment right entirely and adding an affiliate carve-out and competitor bar. On change of control, Section 21.11.B commits M&I to "continue to provide Services" with no termination or re-pricing right (only a volume cap of pre-change levels plus 25%), and redacted Section 11.3 is referenced in 11.1 as a Customer termination route excused from the Termination for Convenience Fee, i.e. a Customer benefit; neither is flagged.

mappings.element: Both parties may assign to a successor.
A successor assignment requires written notice.
Consent to other assignments is not to be unreasonably withheld.
mappings.quote: which consent shall not be unreasonably withheld

proposal.summary: Symmetrical successor carve-out for Customer, mutual written notice, and narrowing of M&I's consent-free route to a true successor by merger or sale of all or substantially all assets.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We broadened Customer's consent-free carve-out to any successor by merger, acquisition or sale of substantially all assets (removing the $100,000,000 acquirer test), added a mutual written-notice requirement, and narrowed M&I's free-assignment proviso to a successor by merger or sale of all or substantially all of its assets, stock or securities so that a corporate reorganization or a sale of the M&I Data Services division alone no longer escapes the consent gate. This puts the clause at our fallback position: successor assignments on written notice, all other assignments by consent not unreasonably withheld.

ops.oldText: (a) M&I's consent need not be obtained in connection with the assignment of this Agreement pursuant to a merger in which Customer is a party and as a result of which the surviving corporation becomes an Affiliate of another bank holding company, bank, savings and loan association or other financial institution having a capital and surplus of at least $100,000,000 so long as the provisions of Section 21.11 are complied with
ops.newText: (a) M&I's consent need not be obtained in connection with the assignment of this Agreement to a successor in a merger, acquisition or sale of all or substantially all of Customer's assets, so long as the provisions of Section 21.11 are complied with

ops.oldText: (b) M&I may freely assign this Agreement (i) in connection with a merger, corporate reorganization or sale of all or substantially all of its assets, stock or securities, or (ii) to any entity which is a successor to the assets or the business of the M&I Data Services division of M&I.
ops.newText: (b) M&I may freely assign this Agreement to a successor in connection with a merger or sale of all or substantially all of its assets, stock or securities.

ops.text: The assigning party shall give the other party written notice of any assignment made under clause (a) or (b) above.
